entities.name: Yumok
entities.description: Nation of northern Terisiare whose tribes considered artifacts anathema.

entities.name: Sarinth
entities.description: Land south of Yumok that the Yumok attacked.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: Union to which Yumok contributed shamans and witch-priests.

entities.name: Chayum-Icha
entities.description: Of the Ingatl tribe, Yumok representative in the Union of the Third Path.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact fished up by the Yumok.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Received the Golgothian Sylex at Terisia City in 36 AR.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: Where the Yumok brought the Sylex to Feldon.

events.summary: The Yumok attack Sarinth numerous times before the War.
events.quote: The Yumok attacked Sarinth on numerous occasions before the War

events.summary: The Yumok fish up the Golgothian Sylex and bring it to Feldon.
events.quote: It was the Yumok who fished up the Golgothian Sylex and brought it to Feldon at Terisia City in 36 AR .

relations.quote: Chayum-Icha of the Ingatl tribe was the Yumok's representative during the Union of the Third Path .
